design_brief: A warm café poster featuring a restrained brutalist layout with bold monochrome typography, softened by subtle geometric line-art inspired by maple leaves and autumn forms. High-contrast composition with clean negative space and an understated amber accent that remains effective in grayscale, creating an inviting yet contemporary atmosphere suitable for an A4/A5 print.
color_direction: high-contrast black and warm gray with optional muted autumn amber accents
font_mood: bold geometric sans-serif with a warm, modern editorial feel
